title: dynamics of globalization's impact on democratic reality: a study of the jordanian and saudi cases
core_idea: Analyze how globalization can both promote and undermine democratic practices and determine which effect predominates by balancing opposing trends, using statistical analysis, trend tracking, and a comparative case study of Jordan and Saudi Arabia.
tldr: A comparative study using statistical and trend analyses to assess whether globalization's net effect on democracy in Jordan and Saudi Arabia is predominantly enabling or undermining, and to explain variation between the cases.
